content.text: Inflammation of the dermis & epidermis from direct contact between a substance & the surface of the skin
▪︎MCC of occupational skin disease (healthcare workers, hairdressers)
type IV hypersensitivity reaction to allergens
can spread from initial contact site
: epidermal barrier disruption causes moisture loss & dry skin,  leading to inflammation & pruritis
: dust mites, heat, humidity, stress, irritants, pollen, fur
: avoid triggers, bland lubricants (petroleum jelly, Aquaphor),
avoid products w/ alcohol, fragrances, & astringents
) for acute flares or continued use for flare prevention in patients w/ frequent recurrences
Palmoplantar eczema: recurrent pruritic vesicular rash on palms/soles
Triggers: sweat, stress, warm & humid weather, metals (nickel)
: cold compress, Burrow’s solution, avoid triggers,
